column2: a small cottage with one lit window beside a long empty road winding away to distant hills, a tiny figure at the gate looking down the road
a figure opening a door to find a large raven on the doorstep holding a sealed letter in its beak
a figure seated with back turned to an open doorway, through the doorway a path leads to mountains, the figure looks at the floor
an old cloaked figure handing a glowing lantern to a young figure, both in profile, a dark forest edge behind them
a lone figure mid-step onto a rope bridge over a deep gorge, mist below, the far side lost in dark
three figures around a small campfire in a forest clearing at night, pairs of eyes watching from the trees
two small figures climbing a steep path toward a castle on a crag under a black sky, a single lit window in the tower
a figure sinking underwater with arms spread, a great coiled serpent below, a single shaft of light from above
a figure kneeling and holding up a small cup that throws light across cave walls
a figure running along a narrow mountain ridge, a storm of birds rising behind them
a figure standing in a ring of fire with arms out, sparks rising, the flames shaped like wings
a figure walking back into a village at dawn carrying a small lantern, villagers waiting at the gate, the same cottage from before
a torn map with a ragged hole in the centre, a tiny figure walking off its edge into blank paper
a tall stack of old books with a candle burning on top, a moth circling the flame
a figure walking a circular path that loops around a mountain and back to a small house, seen from above like a map
